name: coordination-hooks
description: An unconditional project-orientation reminder, opt-in unread-message and role-binding reminders, an idle-wake Stop waiter, and a Git-Controller mistake-prevention gate for coordinated multi-session work.

interface.shortDescription: Reviewable hooks for coordinated Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Adds an unconditional project-orientation reminder plus opt-in unread-message and role-binding reminders, a synchronous nudge-only idle-wake Stop waiter, and a Git-Controller mistake-prevention gate. Deployment-specific guidance stays in the project's native AGENTS.md instructions; launcher-owned watcher, inbox, and cutover integration ship in later reviewed units. Hook revocation remains an explicit operator action in Codex's supported /hooks surface.
defaultPrompt: Explain the installed coordination hook contract.
